The woman enters a glass door and hugs a man with curly hair and glasses wearing a beige sweater. (3) She then hugs another woman in a vibrant pink top. They are surrounded by kitchen appliances and long tables. (4) The woman in black and the woman in pink hold up wine glasses, smiling and gesturing as if toasting. (12) Finally, she stands with the man in the beige sweater and another woman, holding a large clear bottle of wine and laughing while pointing at it.
